Talacre Community Sports Centre Talacre Community Sports Centre in Camden gives local families a place to stay active together, with activities for all ages just a few minutes from Kentish Town West. The sports hall hosts football, basketball, badminton and pickleball sessions all week, while the outdoor 3G pitch brings year-round football to the area. Soft play keeps younger children entertained, and our gymnastics programmes draw families from across the borough. Studios offer yoga and Pilates for adults looking to unwind after a busy day. We run kids' activities and host birthday parties that make celebrations easy. Working alongside Camden Council, we're here to support the local community with space to play, train and connect.
